conditions: 6 AM—Climb out of that bed, jump into your favorite goof-off gear, and get out here. I understand that it's April 1st and you might think I'm fooling, but the flanks of Rendezvous Mountain have had an overnight 4" retooling. If you think that's a spoof, come gather your own proof. The vibe will be fun, yet odd and moody as quiet, cloud-covered skies produce the possibility for passing showers through the day. High temperatures will hover in the mid- to upper 20s at the summit as the village rises towards the 50-degree mark. Generally light winds from the west-southwest will be blowing in the 5 to 20 mph neighborhood. Whether you're wet behind the ears or certified old-school, it's always fun to play the fool. Today is the perfect day for practical jokes and comical gestures, so join in the jubilation with all the other big-mountain jesters. -Lege
